title: Are Calibrated Decision Models Calibrated on Markets? Geolocated News, Markov Switching and a System One Model for Nasdaq-100 Allocation
abstract: arXiv:2611.26716v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Portfolio allocation is driven by probabilities of losses, not only by forecasts of the direction (up/down) of the market. A decision model such as Jev returns a probability for a yes/no question and has been reported to be well calibrated on a set of benchmarks. However, the model's calibration against realised market outcomes has not been tested. In this study, every Friday we ask whether the Nasdaq-100 will close lower four weeks later and compare a two-regime Markov-switching model estimated on data from 1990 to 2026, Jev reading weekly headlines and geolocated news features computed with spatial queries in PostGIS, and their combination. A knowledge probe shows that Jev knows events up to late 2024, so we evaluate it on 88 weeks from January 2025 onwards. None of the models predicts the direction better than the historical base rate. A key finding is that raw Jev overestimates the probability of a decline: its mean forecast is 0.48

translated_title: 校准的决策模型在市场上是否也校准？地理定位新闻、马尔可夫转换与用于纳斯达克100资产配置的系统一模型
translated_abstract: 投资组合配置取决于损失发生的概率，而不仅仅是对市场方向（涨/跌）的预测。像Jev这样的决策模型会对一个是/否问题返回一个概率，并且据报道在一组基准测试上具有良好的校准性。然而，该模型相对于真实市场结果的校准情况尚未得到检验。在本研究中，我们每周五提出这样的问题：纳斯达克100指数是否会在四周后收低，并比较以下方法：一个基于1990年至2026年数据估计的双状态马尔可夫转换模型、一个阅读每周头条新闻并结合通过PostGIS空间查询计算的地理定位新闻特征的Jev模型，以及两者的组合。一项知识探测显示Jev了解截至2024年底的事件，因此我们评估了2025年1月以来的88周数据。没有一个模型在方向预测上优于历史基准比率。一个关键发现是，原始Jev高估了下跌的概率：其平均预测值为0.48
tldr: 该论文首次检验了经过校准的决策模型在真实市场结果上的校准性，通过结合地理定位新闻、马尔可夫转换模型及其组合来预测纳斯达克100指数四周后的下跌概率，发现没有一个模型的方向预测优于历史基准率，且原始Jev高估了下跌概率。
en_tdlr: This paper tests whether a well-calibrated decision model remains calibrated against realized market outcomes by combining geolocated news, a Markov-switching model, and Jev to predict four-week Nasdaq-100 declines, finding that no model beats the historical base rate for direction and that raw Jev overestimates decline probabilities.
